Pueblito.es is a Spanish digital platform focused on restaurant discovery and multilingual digital menu management, with a particular emphasis on small towns and coastal tourist areas. The platform enables users to explore local dining options, access restaurant information, and view digital menus in multiple languages.
The service is designed to support the digitalization of small and medium-sized restaurants, particularly in municipalities with limited online presence, and to improve accessibility for international visitors.
Overview
Pueblito.es operates as a restaurant directory and software platform that allows hospitality businesses to create, manage, and display digital menus online. The platform focuses on improving visibility for restaurants located outside major urban centers, particularly in coastal and rural regions.
Users can browse restaurants by geographic location, cuisine type, and category. Listings include towns in the Valencian Community such as Oropesa del Mar, Benicàssim, and surrounding areas in the province of Castellón.
The platform combines elements of restaurant discovery services and software-as-a-service (SaaS) tools for menu management, allowing businesses to update their offerings dynamically without requiring printed materials.
History
Pueblito.es was founded in 2025 by Ahmad Elsaadi, an entrepreneur with a background in technology and digital services.
The concept originated after Elsaadi relocated to Alcossebre, a coastal town in the province of Castellón, Spain. During his time in the area, he observed that many restaurants lacked accessible online menus, particularly in smaller towns with high seasonal tourism.
This lack of digital presence created difficulties for both residents and visitors attempting to explore local dining options. In response, Elsaadi developed Pueblito.es as a platform to facilitate the digitalization of menus and improve restaurant discoverability.
The initial rollout focused on Alcossebre, where the platform began onboarding local restaurants and testing its digital menu system in a real-world environment.
Development and expansion
Following its initial deployment in Alcossebre, Pueblito.es expanded to nearby coastal municipalities within the province of Castellón, including Benicàssim and Oropesa del Mar.
According to coverage by La Plana al Día, the platform has been introduced in these areas as part of an initiative to digitalize restaurant menus and improve accessibility for international visitors.
The same source reports that the platform supports menu translation into multiple languages and aims to assist restaurants in adapting to tourism demand.
As of 2026, the platform is expanding across the Costa del Azahar and towards Castellón de la Plana, with a focus on scaling its presence among small and medium-sized hospitality businesses.
Features
Multilingual digital menus
A central feature of Pueblito.es is the ability for restaurants to display menus in up to five languages. This functionality is intended to improve accessibility for international tourists and reduce language barriers.
Restaurant discovery
The platform enables users to discover restaurants through:
* Location-based browsing
* Cuisine type
* Dining categories
Digitalization tools for businesses
Pueblito.es provides tools that allow restaurant owners to:
* Create and update digital menus
* Modify prices and items in real time
* Centralize menu information in a single interface
* Share menus through links or QR-based access
Accessibility and tourism focus
The platform emphasizes accessibility for tourists by providing multilingual content and simplified access to restaurant information, particularly in coastal areas with seasonal demand.
Business model
Pueblito.es operates using a digital services model that combines elements of a restaurant directory and subscription-based tools for businesses. Restaurants can join the platform to manage their menus and improve online visibility.
The platform positions itself as a lightweight alternative to larger global services, with a focus on local markets and smaller municipalities.
Position within the sector
Pueblito.es is part of the broader digital transformation of the hospitality industry, where restaurants increasingly adopt online tools for menu management, customer engagement, and discovery.
Unlike global platforms that prioritize large urban markets, Pueblito.es focuses on smaller towns and underserved areas in Spain.
Purpose and impact
The platform aims to:
* Improve visibility for small and medium-sized restaurants
* Facilitate access to information for tourists
* Support the digital transition of local businesses
* Enhance the dining discovery experience in smaller municipalities
